Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset the recent price pullback.

Silver.note: Deep historical discount and strong solar demand provide a solid floor.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits and robust grid investment demand support premiums.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and renewed global nuclear capacity additions.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Continued Indonesian supply growth outpaces stainless and battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapses indicate tight concentrate supply supporting prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector offsets infrastructure stimulus, capping upside.

Coal.note: Balanced seaborne market with steady Indian demand offsetting European weakness.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and EV motor demand support long-term pricing.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production supports demand, though battery adoption remains gradual.

PGM.note: Substitution by palladium and weak global auto production constrain near-term upside.

Potash.note: Market rebalancing after past shocks with steady global agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Strict Chinese capacity caps and rising green energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure balances iron ore weakness with structural copper and uranium upside.
